sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了千方百计来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏（Jane Doe）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查出了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是罪案档案（Casefile Presents）推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本集最初发布于 Casefile 的 Patreon、Apple Premium 和 Spotify Premium 订阅频道，作为给付费订阅者的早期福利。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些单集的设计稍短一些，让我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件范围。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 您可以在首选平台上支持 Casefile，以便提早收听这些无广告的单集。

sentences.en: On the evening of Tuesday, May 10, 1994, staff at a home on Grano Street in the regional Victorian town of Ararat,
sentences.zh: 1994年5月10日星期二傍晚，维多利亚州区域小镇阿拉腊特（Ararat）格拉诺街（Grano Street）一处住宅的工作人员，

sentences.en: served up dinner at the usual time of 6pm.
sentences.zh: 在平时傍晚6点准时端上了晚餐。

sentences.en: The home was a residential care unit for people with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 这栋住宅是一个残疾人日夜照料护理单元。

sentences.en: The unit's five inhabitants were cared for round the clock by live-in staff from the Department of Health and Community Services.
sentences.zh: 该单元的五名住户由卫生与社区服务部（Department of Health and Community Services）的驻地员工全天候照料。

sentences.en: It was their job to support and empower the residents to live as independently as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作是支持和赋能居民，让他们尽可能独立地生活。

sentences.en: But, as the staff and residents gathered around the dining table to eat their dinner together, one chair remained empty.
sentences.zh: 然而，当工作人员和居民围坐在餐桌旁一起吃晚饭时，却有一个座位空着。

sentences.en: The cheerful and gentle fifth resident of the unit, 41-year-old Lindsay Jellett, was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 单元里第五位性格开朗、温和的住户——41岁的林赛·耶利特（Lindsay Jellett）却不见踪影。

sentences.en: Lindsay Jellett was a creature of habit.
sentences.zh: 林赛·耶利特是个习惯成自然的人。

sentences.en: Shortly before four o'clock that afternoon, he asked the staff at Grano Street for permission to go for his daily walk.
sentences.zh: 那天下午不到四点，他向格拉诺街的工作人员请示去进行日常散步。

sentences.en: This was Lindsay's favourite part of the day, the only time he was free and unrestricted.
sentences.zh: 这是林赛一天中最喜欢的部分，也是他唯一自由且不受束缚的时光。

sentences.en: Although it was rare for Lindsay to be late, he loved food, and his carers were sure he'd be back before long.
sentences.zh: 尽管林赛迟归的情况很少见，但他很爱吃东西，照料者确信他很快就会回来。

sentences.en: They put his plate in the microwave so they could reheat his dinner as soon as he showed up.
sentences.zh: 他们把他的盘子放进微波炉里，这样他一出现就能马上给他加热晚餐。

sentences.en: But by 6.30, there was still no sign of Lindsay.
sentences.zh: 但到了6点30分，依然不见林赛的踪影。

sentences.en: His carers checked his bedroom and the backyard in case he'd returned without them noticing.
sentences.zh: 他的照料者检查了他的卧室和后院，以防他回来而他们没有注意到。

sentences.en: One of the staff drove around the streets on the lookout but had no luck finding him.
sentences.zh: 其中一名工作人员开车在街上寻找，但没有找到他。

sentences.en: By 7 o'clock, they were really worried.
sentences.zh: 到了7点钟，他们真的很担心。

sentences.en: It was dark and cold outside, and Lindsay had never come home this late.
sentences.zh: 外面又黑又冷，林赛从来没有这么晚回家过。

sentences.en: The police were promptly called.
sentences.zh: 警方随即被报警叫来。

sentences.en: Lindsay was last seen by Grano Street staff at 3.45pm as he set off for his afternoon walk.
sentences.zh: 格拉诺街的工作人员最后一次见到林赛是在下午3点45分，当时他正出发去下午散步。

sentences.en: While a traumatic head injury at the age of two had left Lindsay with cognitive disability and developmental delays, he was more than capable of navigating his daily routine.
sentences.zh: 虽然两岁时遭受过创伤性脑损伤导致林赛伴有认知障碍和发育迟缓，但他完全有能力应付日常起居。

sentences.en: He could shower, feed, and dress himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己会洗澡、吃饭和穿衣。

sentences.en: He couldn't read or write, but he could communicate coherently, count to 30, and knew the value of money to $10.
sentences.zh: 他虽然不会读写，但能连贯沟通，能数到30，并且知道10美元的货币价值。

sentences.en: Lindsay particularly loved walking to a nearby golf course where he'd collect lost golf balls and bring them home to clean and give to his friends.
sentences.zh: 林赛特别喜欢走到附近的一个高尔夫球场，在那里收集丢失的高尔夫球，带回家清洗后送给朋友。

sentences.en: His other favourite walk was to the main street of town.
sentences.zh: 他另一个最喜欢的散步路线是去镇上的主街。

sentences.en: Lindsay had a sweet tooth and he'd spend his $5 daily allowance on cigarettes, coffee, Coca-Cola, and biscuits.
sentences.zh: 林赛爱吃甜食，他会把5美元的日常零花钱花在香烟、咖啡、可口可乐和饼干上。

sentences.en: One of his legs was shorter than the other, so he tended to shuffle along slowly, often stopping to talk to people in the streets.
sentences.zh: 他的一条腿比另一条短，所以他走起路来往往慢慢地拖着步子，经常停下来和街上的人说话。

sentences.en: In the first few months of living at Grano Street, Lindsay walked so much that he wore out several pairs of shoes.
sentences.zh: 在住进格拉诺街的前几个月里，林赛走得实在太多，以至于穿坏了好几双鞋。

sentences.en: He walked for hours each day, but was always home in time for dinner.
sentences.zh: 他每天散步几个小时，但总能在晚饭前回家。

sentences.en: With Lindsay now failing to return home, time was of the essence.
sentences.zh: 鉴于林赛现在未能回家，时间可以说是刻不容缓。

sentences.en: It was a frosty, rainy night and he was ill-prepared for the weather, having left home in just a pair of trousers and a blue fleece top.
sentences.zh: 这是一个霜雨交加的夜晚，他对外面的天气毫无准备，离家时只穿了一条裤子和一件蓝色抓绒上衣。

sentences.en: Adding to the urgency was the fact that at 8 o'clock each night, Lindsay took the drug Tegretol to treat his epilepsy.
sentences.zh: 更显紧迫的是，林赛每晚8点要服用药物得理妥（Tegretol）来治疗癫痫。

sentences.en: A missed dose could put him at risk of a seizure.
sentences.zh: 漏服一次可能会让他面临癫痫发作的风险。

sentences.en: As luck would have it, the Ararat branch of the State Emergency Service were in the middle of a training session and could be deployed immediately to help police with the search.
sentences.zh: 好在州紧急服务局（State Emergency Service）阿拉腊特分局当时正在进行训练，可以立即部署协助警方搜寻。

sentences.en: They were advised that Lindsay was timid and there was a possibility he might hide if approached by someone he didn't know.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知林赛性格内向，如果遇到不认识的人可能会躲起来。

sentences.en: Search units scoured the town by car and on foot, with the SES truck driving slowly along the back roads using a searchlight to sweep the surrounding paddocks and farMs.
sentences.zh: 搜寻小组乘车和步行搜遍了全镇，紧急服务局的卡车沿着乡村小路缓慢行驶，用探照灯扫视周围的牧场和农场。

sentences.en: Sheds and outbuildings were checked in case Lindsay was seeking shelter from the bad weather.
sentences.zh: 工棚和附属建筑也受到了检查，以防林赛是为了躲避恶劣天气而寻求庇护。

sentences.en: But he was nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 但他还是不见踪影。

sentences.en: The following morning of Wednesday May 11, police narrowed in on Lindsay's home.
sentences.zh: 第二天5月11日星期三上午，警方将搜索范围缩小到了林赛的住所附近。

sentences.en: They rechecked the residence and the surrounding area, just in case he'd returned and was too frightened to come inside because he knew he was late.
sentences.zh: 他们重新检查了住所及周边地区，以防他已经返回，但因为知道自己迟到了而害怕进来。

sentences.en: Yet, there was still no sign of him.
sentences.zh: 然而，依然没有他的踪迹。

sentences.en: All available crews from police stations in neighbouring towns joined the search, with the air wing dispatched to search overhead.
sentences.zh: 邻近城镇警察局的所有可用警力都加入了搜寻，航空分队也被派往空中搜寻。

sentences.en: With no reports coming in about a lost or disorientated man, police contacted all the local radio stations to broadcast Lindsay's details,
sentences.zh: 由于没有收到关于失踪或迷路男子的报告，警方联系了当地所有广播电台播报林赛的体貌特征，

sentences.en: so the entire community would know to keep a look out.
sentences.zh: 以便整个社区的人都知道要多加留意。

sentences.en: A local farmer heard the reports and said on a drive around the roads that bordered his property.
sentences.zh: 当地一位农民听到了广播报道，便开车巡视了一下他房产边界的道路。

sentences.en: As he made his way along Down Road, a dirt stretch roughly two kilometres northeast of Lindsay Jellett's home,
sentences.zh: 当他沿着唐路（Down Road）行驶时——这是一段距离林赛·耶利特家东北约两公里的泥土路，

sentences.en: the farmer saw what looked like a white running shoe on the grassy verge at the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 这位农民看到路边草地上似乎有一只白色的运动鞋。

sentences.en: He kept going, but the image of the shoe worried him.
sentences.zh: 他继续往前开，但鞋子的影象让他感到不安。

sentences.en: He did a U-turn and drove back towards it.
sentences.zh: 他掉了个头，朝着那个方向开回去。

sentences.en: As he approached, he realised there were actually two shoes.
sentences.zh: 当他走近时，他意识到其实有两只鞋。

sentences.en: The farmer pulled over on the opposite side of the road and got out of his car.
sentences.zh: 这位农民把车停在路对侧，然后下了车。

sentences.en: Lying on the grassy verge was the body of Lindsay Jellett.
sentences.zh: 躺在草地边缘的是林赛·耶利特的尸体。

sentences.en: Lindsay's blue fleecy top was pulled up, exposing his thin white torso, which was stained with a liver-coloured patch of congealed blood under the skin.
sentences.zh: 林赛的蓝色抓绒上衣被拉了上去，露出了他瘦削的白色躯干，皮下有一片肝色凝固血液的污斑。

sentences.en: His eyes and mouth were half-open, his left cheek grazed, and his nose unnaturally bent.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛和嘴巴半开着，左脸颊有擦伤，鼻子扭曲得不自然。

sentences.en: While his belt was still buckled, it had been melted apart on the left-hand side.
sentences.zh: 虽然他的皮带还扣着，但在左侧已经被融断了。

sentences.en: His white running shoes were still on his feet, but the right one was crushed, its sole bursting from torn stitching.
sentences.zh: 他脚上还穿着白色的运动鞋，但右边那只被压碎了，鞋底从裂开的缝线处爆裂开来。

sentences.en: Three packets of cigarettes and a cigarette tin lay next to his body, with a five-dollar bill discarded at his right elbow.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体旁放着三包香烟和一个烟盒，右肘旁扔着一张五美元的钞票。

sentences.en: Nearby was an empty beer can.
sentences.zh: 附近有一个空啤酒罐。

sentences.en: It appeared as though Lindsay Jellett had been struck by a car.
sentences.zh: 看样子林赛·耶利特是被汽车撞了。

sentences.en: Not only were there obvious crush injuries to his legs and torso, tyre tracks in the dirt road led straight to his body.
sentences.zh: 他的腿部和躯干不仅有明显的碾压伤，泥土路上的轮胎印也直接通向他的尸体。

sentences.en: But as soon as the crash investigators arrived from Melbourne, they knew this wasn't a standard hit-and-run.
sentences.zh: 但当墨尔本的交通事故调查人员一到达，他们就知道这不是一起标准的肇事逃逸案。

sentences.en: There are six elements that correlate with this type of impact.
sentences.zh: 这类撞击通常对应着六个要素。

sentences.en: The first three are injuries to the shins, hip and head, as the victim strikes the vehicle's bumper bar, bonnet and windscreen or roof.
sentences.zh: 前三个要素是小腿、臀部和头部的伤情，因为受害者会撞击车辆的保险杠、发动机罩以及挡风玻璃或车顶。

sentences.en: Then there's the scene itself.
sentences.zh: 然后是现场本身。

sentences.en: Blood from the victim, as well as some trace of the car involved, such as broken glass or paint flakes, are expected to be found.
sentences.zh: 现场通常会发现受害者的血液，以及涉案汽车的痕迹，例如碎玻璃或漆片。

sentences.en: The sixth element is that the victim is usually shoeless.
sentences.zh: 第六个要素是受害者通常鞋子会脱落。

sentences.en: It is a little-known phenomenon, but when people are hit by cars, they are generally knocked clean out of their footwear.
sentences.zh: 这是一个鲜为人知的现象，当人们被汽车撞到时，他们脚上的鞋子通常会被直接撞飞。

sentences.en: In fact, the crash investigators had never attended a hit-and-run where the victim was still wearing shoes.
sentences.zh: 事实上，交通事故调查人员以前从未遇到过受害者鞋子依然穿在脚上的肇事逃逸案。

sentences.en: A cursory examination of the scene showed that none of these six elements were present.
sentences.zh: 对现场的粗略检查表明，这六个要素无一符合。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Lindsay's body was arranged too neatly by the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 此外，林赛的尸体在路边摆放得太整齐了。

sentences.en: If he'd been hit by a car while walking, his body would have been flung and landed awkwardly.
sentences.zh: 如果他在走路时被车撞了，他的身体会被撞飞并以别扭的姿势落地。

sentences.en: His top being pulled up also indicated that someone had gripped him under the arms and dragged him along.
sentences.zh: 他的上衣被拉高也表明有人曾抓住他的腋下将他拖拽过。

sentences.en: This was supported by marks in the road, with two parallel lines appearing to have been made by the heels of Lindsay's shoes.
sentences.zh: 路面上的痕迹支持了这一推断，两条平行线似乎是由林赛鞋子的鞋跟造成的。

sentences.en: Lindsay might not have been hit by a car, but from his injuries, it was obvious that he had indeed been run over.
sentences.zh: 林赛可能没有被汽车撞飞，但从他的伤势来看，他确实被汽车碾压过。

sentences.en: He had abdominal bruising consistent with a car tyre, and the lower parts of his legs had severe crush injuries.
sentences.zh: 他的腹部有符合汽车轮胎特征的瘀伤，下肢有严重的碾压伤。

sentences.en: There were smears of grease on his body and clothing, as well as burn marks where he'd come into contact with the hot exhaust section underneath a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 他的身体和衣服上有润滑脂的污迹，以及接触到车辆底盘热排气管部位而造成的烧伤痕迹。

sentences.en: Yet, the lack of blood at the crime scene intrigued investigators.
sentences.zh: 然而，犯罪现场缺乏血迹引起了调查人员的兴趣。

sentences.en: This indicated that Lindsay was already dead when his body was run over.
sentences.zh: 这表明林赛在尸体被车碾压时已经死亡。

sentences.en: A lack of bleeding confirmed this theory.
sentences.zh: 没有出血证实了这一理论。

sentences.en: Marks in the dirt showed that Lindsay had most likely been dumped from a vehicle before being dragged to the side of the road and then run over on the verge.
sentences.zh: 泥土中的痕迹表明，林赛很可能是从一辆车上被倾倒下来，然后被拖到路边，接着在路边草地上遭到碾压。

sentences.en: Fibres consistent with his trousers were found near the drag marks, and there were acceleration scuff marks alongside his body.
sentences.zh: 在拖拽痕迹附近发现了与其裤子材质相符的纤维，他的尸体旁还有急加速留下的轮胎摩擦痕迹。

sentences.en: The resulting spray of gravel, coupled with the tyre tracks, indicated that a vehicle had reversed to where Lindsay's body lay, and then backed right over him.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的飞溅碎石，加上轮胎印，表明一辆车倒车开到了林赛尸体所在的地方，然后直接从他身上倒了过去。

sentences.en: Twice.
sentences.zh: 倒了两次。

sentences.en: After running over Lindsay, the car then turned around and headed in the direction of Ararat.
sentences.zh: 汽车碾压过林赛后，又调头朝阿拉腊特方向驶去。

sentences.en: The pathologist conducting Lindsay's autopsy couldn't determine what had caused his death.
sentences.zh: 对林赛进行尸检的病理学家无法确定他的死因。

sentences.en: Given Lindsay's history of epilepsy, she considered a syndrome known as Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy, or SUDAP.
sentences.zh: 鉴于林赛的癫痫病史，她考虑了一种被称为癫痫猝死（Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy，简称 SUDAP）的综合征。

sentences.en: This is where an otherwise healthy person with epilepsy dies prematurely, typically in their sleep.
sentences.zh: 这是指原本健康的癫痫患者过早死亡，通常发生在睡眠中。

sentences.en: In cases of SUDAP, a post-mortem examination shows no cause of death.
sentences.zh: 在癫痫猝死病例中，尸检显示不出死因。

sentences.en: Sometimes, there are signs that a seizure has occurred, such as the individual losing control of their bladder, but Lindsay's autopsy showed that his bladder was full.
sentences.zh: 有时会有癫痫发作的迹象，例如患者失禁，但林赛的尸检显示他的膀胱是满的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, if Lindsay had died from SUDAP, it didn't explain why someone would drag him to the side of the road and run him over with a car.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果林赛死于癫痫猝死，这无法解释为什么有人要把他拖到路边并用车碾压他。

sentences.en: Crash investigators sought to identify the type of car that had run Lindsay over.
sentences.zh: 交通事故调查人员试图确定碾压林赛的汽车类型。

sentences.en: The owner of a local tyre shop agreed to accompany police to the scene.
sentences.zh: 当地一家轮胎店的老板同意陪同警方前往现场。

sentences.en: Upon seeing the tracks, he was certain they'd been made by Bridgestone Eager S340 tyres.
sentences.zh: 看到轮胎印后，他确信那是普利司通（Bridgestone）Eager S340轮胎留下的。

sentences.en: Smears of red fluid on Lindsay's white running shoes were suspected by one investigator to be automatic transmission fluid.
sentences.zh: 林赛白色运动鞋上的红色液体污迹被一名调查人员怀疑是自动变速箱油。

sentences.en: If he was correct, this meant police were looking for an automatic car, probably an older model which would be more likely to leak.
sentences.zh: 如果他的判断正确，这就意味着警方在寻找一辆自动挡汽车，可能是一辆更有可能漏油的老旧车型。

sentences.en: Leaking transmission fluid didn't necessarily drip out.
sentences.zh: 漏出的变速箱油不一定直接滴出来。

sentences.en: Instead, it formed a film over the car's transmission pan located in its undercarriage.
sentences.zh: 相反，它会在汽车底盘里的变速箱油底壳上形成一层油膜。

sentences.en: The fluid could have been transferred to Lindsay's shoes when the car ran over him.
sentences.zh: 当汽车从林赛身上碾过时，这些液体可能转移到了林赛的鞋子上。

sentences.en: The fact that Lindsay's body was smeared with black grease also suggested an older car.
sentences.zh: 林赛尸体上沾有黑色润滑脂这一事实也暗示这是一辆旧车。

sentences.en: Slowly but surely, a picture of the wanted vehicle emerged, an automatic, older-style car with Bridgestone Eager S340 tyres.
sentences.zh: 一辆装有普利司通 Eager S340 轮胎的自动挡旧款汽车的轮廓，慢慢但清晰地浮现了出来。

sentences.en: If the vehicle had left traces on Lindsay, then he'd likely left traces on the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 如果这辆车在林赛身上留下了痕迹，那么他也很可能在车上留下了痕迹。

sentences.en: The only problem was that the evidence would largely be underneath the car, rather than obvious visible damage to the car's exterior.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是，这些证据主要在车身底部，而不是汽车外部明显的可见损坏。

sentences.en: Detectives began looking into Lindsay's life for clues as to who could be responsible.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始调查林赛的生活，寻找谁可能是凶手的线索。

sentences.en: By all accounts, Lindsay Jellett was a harmless and friendly man who was well-known and well-liked in his community.
sentences.zh: 根据各方说法，林赛·耶利特是一个无害且友好的人，在社区里广为人知且深受喜爱。

sentences.en: The more the detectives learnt about Lindsay, the harder it was to imagine why anyone would want to kill him.
sentences.zh: 侦探们对林赛了解得越多，就越难以想象为什么会有人想要杀害他。

sentences.en: They did a doorknock of the houses surrounding Lindsay's, many of which housed residents with disabilities, but no one had a bad thing to say about him.
sentences.zh: 他们对林赛住所周围的房屋进行了逐门走访，其中许多房屋住着残疾人居民，但没有人对他说过一句坏话。

sentences.en: On the afternoon that Lindsay's body was discovered, a roadblock was organised on Grano Street for the same period of time that Lindsay went missing,
sentences.zh: 在发现林赛尸体的当天下午，警方在格拉诺街设立了路障，时间段与林赛失踪的时间相吻合，

sentences.en: with detectives stopping all cars to ask if anyone had seen Lindsay walking the previous day.
sentences.zh: 侦探们拦下所有汽车，询问是否有人在前一天看到林赛走路。

sentences.en: Grano Street is one thoroughfare through Ararat, and 4pm is a change of shift time for workers for the local prison and railway, as well as health and community services staff.
sentences.zh: 格拉诺街是穿过阿拉腊特的一条交通要道，下午4点是当地监狱、铁路工人以及卫生和社区服务人员交接班的时间。

sentences.en: One man stopped at the roadblock knew Lindsay by sight.
sentences.zh: 在路障处被拦下的一名男子对林赛面熟。

sentences.en: He told detectives that at around 4pm the day before, he'd seen Lindsay climbing into a car that was parallel parked to the curb a short distance away from his house.
sentences.zh: 他告诉侦探，就在前一天下午4点左右，他看到林赛爬进了一辆平行停在离他家不远路边的汽车里。

sentences.en: It was an older model brown-coloured sedan with a red LPG gas sticker on its number plate.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆老式棕色轿车，车牌上有红色的液化石油气（LPG）贴纸。

sentences.en: The man had caught a glimpse of the driver.
sentences.zh: 这名男子瞥了一眼司机。

sentences.en: It was a middle-aged woman with dark hair who he didn't recognise.
sentences.zh: 那是一个他不认识的中年黑发女人。

sentences.en: This description immediately gave investigators pause.
sentences.zh: 这个描述立即让调查人员陷入了沉思。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 罪案档案节目稍后继续。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: In 1955, when Lindsay Jeller was two and a half years old, his mother was pushing him and his twin sister along in a pram.
sentences.zh: 1955年，当林赛·耶利特两岁半时，他的母亲正推着他和双胞胎姐姐坐在婴儿车里。

sentences.en: As she edged the pram out between two parked cars, a truck suddenly struck the front of it.
sentences.zh: 当她推着婴儿车从两辆停放的汽车之间挤过去时，一辆卡车突然撞上了车头。

sentences.en: The force of the collision threw Lindsay heavily onto the road.
sentences.zh: 撞击的力量把林赛重重地甩到了路上。

sentences.en: While his twin sister Judith was unhurt, Lindsay suffered severe brain damage and was in a coma for nine weeks.
sentences.zh: 虽然他的双胞胎姐姐朱迪思（Judith）没有受伤，但林赛遭受了严重的脑损伤，并昏迷了九周。

sentences.en: By the time he was finally allowed to return home from the hospital, his behaviour had changed significantly and his parents struggled to control him.
sentences.zh: 当他终于被允许出院回家时，他的行为发生了巨大变化，他的父母很难控制他。

sentences.en: When Lindsay was seven, his parents made the difficult decision to place him in a live-in care facility.
sentences.zh: 林赛七岁时，他的父母做出了一个艰难的决定，把他送进了一个寄宿护理机构。

sentences.en: They visited him often and he was occasionally allowed home.
sentences.zh: 他们经常去看望他，偶尔也允许他回家。

sentences.en: In time, Lindsay grew into a gentle and loving man.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，林赛成长为一个温柔慈爱的人。

sentences.en: He'd pick flowers from the garden to give to visitors and was always quick with a hug and a joke.
sentences.zh: 他会从花园里摘花送给来访者，而且总是很快就能给别人一个拥抱和一句笑话。

sentences.en: When Lindsay's parents passed away, his twin sister Judith became his closest living relative.
sentences.zh: 在林赛的父母去世后，他的双胞胎姐姐朱迪思成了他最亲近的在世亲人。

sentences.en: Even though she had her own health problems and priorities in life,
sentences.zh: 尽管她有自己的健康问题和生活重心，

sentences.en: Judith always made time to visit her brother.
sentences.zh: 朱迪思总是抽出时间去看望她的弟弟。

sentences.en: She'd often take her four children with her, making the four-hour round trip to Ararat from their home in the suburb of Melton.
sentences.zh: 她经常带着她的四个孩子，从梅尔顿（Melton）郊区的家出发，来回花四个小时去阿拉腊特。

sentences.en: They'd take Lindsay out to lunch or to visit a museum or park.
sentences.zh: 他们会带林赛出去吃午饭，或者参观博物馆或公园。

sentences.en: Judith bought Lindsay clothes and anything else he needed, treating him to chocolate, lollies and sweet drinks.
sentences.zh: 朱迪思给林赛买衣服以及他需要的其他东西，用巧克力、糖果和甜饮料犒劳他。

sentences.en: While the drive there and back with a car full of kids was gruelling, it was never a chore.
sentences.zh: 虽然开车带着一满车孩子去那里和回来的路程很劳累，但这从来都不是一件苦差事。

sentences.en: A friend of Judith's said she had more patience, love and understanding for Lindsay than she did for her own children.
sentences.zh: 朱迪的一位朋友说，比起自己的亲生孩子，她对林赛有着更多的耐心、爱心和理解。

sentences.en: In late 1993, the facility that Lindsay had lived in for 20 years was shut down
sentences.zh: 1993年后期，林赛住了20年的机构被关闭了，

sentences.en: as part of the Victorian government's commitment to move residents from institutions into the community.
sentences.zh: 作为维多利亚州政府将居民从收容机构转移到社区中的承诺的一部分。

sentences.en: Lindsay made the move to the Grano Street Residential Unit, where Judith continued to visit every month or so.
sentences.zh: 林赛搬到了格拉诺街住宅单元，朱迪此后大约每月去探望一次。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, May 10, 1994, Judith scheduled a 1 o'clock meeting with Grano Street staff, followed by a 3 o'clock meeting with support staff from a nearby organisation
sentences.zh: 1994年5月10日星期二，朱迪安排在下午1点与格拉诺街的工作人员开会，随后在下午3点与附近一家机构的支持人员开会，

sentences.en: that ran a day program Lindsay attended.
sentences.zh: 该机构运营着一个林赛参加的日间项目。

sentences.en: She did this every so often to check how her brother was doing.
sentences.zh: 她每隔一段时间就会这样做一次，以查看她弟弟的情况。

sentences.en: Judith picked Lindsay up at 11.30am, then took him to the Ararat RSL to play the pokies.
sentences.zh: 朱迪于上午11点30分接走林赛，然后带他去阿拉arat RSL玩老虎机。

sentences.en: After having lunch together, they headed to Lindsay's Grano Street unit for their 1 o'clock meeting.
sentences.zh: 两人一起吃过午饭后，前往林赛的格拉诺街寓所参加下午1点的会议。

sentences.en: The staff told Judith that her brother's epilepsy was under control, but that he should avoid beer in case it triggered a seizure.
sentences.zh: 工作人员告诉朱迪，她弟弟的癫痫得到了控制，但应该避免喝啤酒，以免诱发发作。

sentences.en: Beer wasn't really an issue with Lindsay.
sentences.zh: 啤酒对林赛来说其实并不是什么问题。

sentences.en: He mainly drank coffee or coke.
sentences.zh: 他主要喝咖啡或可乐。

sentences.en: With an hour to kill before their next appointment,
sentences.zh: 在下一个预约之前有一个小时的空闲时间，

sentences.en: Judith took Lindsay to the shops to buy him a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 朱迪带林赛去商店给他买了几样东西。

sentences.en: Then they attended their 3pm meeting, after which Judith dropped Lindsay back at Grano Street at around 3.40am.
sentences.zh: 然后他们参加了下午3点的会议，之后朱迪在下午3点40分左右将林赛送回了格拉诺街。

sentences.en: She bid Lindsay goodbye just as he was preparing for his afternoon walk.
sentences.zh: 就在林赛准备下午散步时，她向他道别。

sentences.en: Before leaving,
sentences.zh: 离开之前，

sentences.en: Judith left some treats in her brother's bedroom for him to enjoy later.
sentences.zh: 朱迪在弟弟的卧室里留下了一些零食，供他稍后享用。

sentences.en: When Lindsay was reported missing later that evening, his carers attempted to call Judith at her home in Melton, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 当晚晚些时候林赛被报告失踪时，他的护理人员试图给住在梅尔顿家中的朱迪打电话，但无人接听。

sentences.en: They left her a message and she called them back at 8pm.
sentences.zh: 他们给她留了言，她在晚上8点回了电话。

sentences.en: They informed to Judith that Lindsay hadn't returned home after his walk.
sentences.zh: 他们通知朱迪，林赛散步后没有回家。

sentences.en: She shared their concerns, but offered a simple explanation.
sentences.zh: 她分享了他们的担忧，但提出了一个简单的解释。

sentences.en: She'd given Lindsay $25 that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午她给了林赛25美元。

sentences.en: It might have been possible that he was spending it in town.
sentences.zh: 他有可能是在镇上花掉了。

sentences.en: Fifteen minutes later,
sentences.zh: 十五分钟后，

sentences.en: Judith called back having just remembered a significant incident.
sentences.zh: 朱迪回了电话，因为她刚想起一个重要的情况。

sentences.en: Years prior, Lindsay had run away and was found wandering down a highway into Melbourne en route to Judith's home.
sentences.zh: 几年前，林赛曾离家出走，被人发现沿着一条通往墨尔本的高速公路游荡，当时正赶往朱迪家。

sentences.en: She recommended that the search party keep an eye out for him on the outskirts of town and along the railway lines, before asking if it was raining.
sentences.zh: 她建议搜寻队在镇郊和铁路线沿线留意他，随后问是否在下雨。

sentences.en: Her voice was tinged with worry when she remarked, He doesn't have his coat with him.
sentences.zh: 她的声音中带着担忧，说道：“他没有带外套。”

sentences.en: When Lindsay was found dead, detectives paid Judith a visit in Melton.
sentences.zh: 当林赛被发现死亡时，侦探们拜访了住在梅尔顿的朱迪。

sentences.en: Having already been delivered the news, she was visibly upset, but she managed to tell the detectives about her final encounter with her brother the afternoon prior.
sentences.zh: 在已经得知死讯后，她显得心烦意乱，但她还是设法向侦探们讲述了前一天下午她与弟弟的最后一次见面。

sentences.en: She detailed their lunch, errands, and meetings, before recalling one notable moment.
sentences.zh: 她详细讲述了他们的午餐、杂物采购和会议，随后回忆起了一个值得注意的时刻。

sentences.en: While in town, Judith ducked into a pharmacy, leaving Lindsay waiting outside.
sentences.zh: 在镇上时，朱迪顺便进了一家药店，留林赛在外面等待。

sentences.en: When she came out,
sentences.zh: 当她出来时，

sentences.en: Lindsay was talking to a woman parked in a battered old van.
sentences.zh: 林赛正在和一辆停在一辆破旧旧货车里的女人说话。

sentences.en: He told her that he'd just won money at the pokies.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，他刚在老虎机上赢了钱。

sentences.en: To the detectives, this was a solid lead.
sentences.zh: 对侦探们来说，这是一个坚实的线索。

sentences.en: Could Lindsay have been targeted by someone who thought he might be in possession of some winnings?
sentences.zh: 林赛会不会被认为他可能持有奖金的人盯上了？

sentences.en: Wondering whether drugs or alcohol could have also played a role in Lindsay's death, the detectives asked Judith about the medications her brother had been taking.
sentences.zh: 侦探们想知道毒品或酒精是否也在林赛的死中发挥了作用，于是向朱迪询问了她弟弟一直在服用的药物。

sentences.en: As far as Judith knew, the only thing Lindsay took was his anti-seizure medication, Tegretol.
sentences.zh: 据朱迪所知，林赛唯一服用的药物是他的抗癫痫药特格列醇（Tegretol）。

sentences.en: In regards to the beer can found near Lindsay's body,
sentences.zh: 关于在林赛尸体附近发现的啤酒罐，

sentences.en: Judith said she didn't think her brother really drank beer.
sentences.zh: 朱迪说她认为她弟弟并不真的喝酒。

sentences.en: He had done so on occasion, but it left him sleepy.
sentences.zh: 他偶尔喝过，但这会让他感到困倦。

sentences.en: But there was one incident that raised Judith's concerns.
sentences.zh: 但有一件事引起了朱迪的担忧。

sentences.en: A few months earlier, Lindsay had been visiting Judith when she ducked across the road to visit a neighbour.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，林赛正在拜访朱迪，当时她横过马路去拜访一位邻居。

sentences.en: When she came back,
sentences.zh: 当她回来时，

sentences.en: Lindsay said he was tired and didn't feel well.
sentences.zh: 林赛说他很累，感觉很不舒服。

sentences.en: He went to lay down, telling his sister he was having a fit.
sentences.zh: 他去躺下了，告诉姐姐他正在发病。

sentences.en: She took his pulse, but it was normal.
sentences.zh: 她量了脉搏，但很正常。

sentences.en: Judith called one of Lindsay's carers, who advised her to roll him onto his side, but by this time,
sentences.zh: 朱迪打电话给林赛的一位护理人员，对方建议她把他翻身侧卧，但此时，

sentences.en: Lindsay appeared to be sleeping.
sentences.zh: 林赛看起来像是在睡觉。

sentences.en: The carer assured Judith he was probably fine, but when he wouldn't wake up after 20 minutes,
sentences.zh: 护理人员向朱迪保证他可能没事，但在20分钟后他仍未醒来时，

sentences.en: Judith called an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 朱迪拨打了救护车。

sentences.en: After the paramedics took him away,
sentences.zh: 在急救人员将他带走后，

sentences.en: Judith noticed a drawer had been opened in her bedroom, and she wondered if Lindsay had taken some of her medication.
sentences.zh: 朱迪发现她卧室里有一个抽屉被打开了，她想知道林赛是否拿了她的一些药。

sentences.en: Judith suffered from chronic back pain and a litany of other health problems, for which she kept a wide assortment of medication in her home.
sentences.zh: 朱迪患有慢性背痛和一长串其他健康问题，为此她在家里存放了各种各样的药物。

sentences.en: Detectives had noticed this for themselves, as hundreds of bottles of medicine lined her shelves.
sentences.zh: 侦探们自己也注意到了这一点，因为数百瓶药摆满了她的书架。

sentences.en: Judith said she'd rang the hospital and shared her suspicion that Lindsay might have taken Valium or painkillers.
sentences.zh: 朱迪说她给医院打了电话，并分享了她的怀疑，即林赛可能服用了安定或止痛药。

sentences.en: The doctors gave him an antidote for Valium, after which he was fine.
sentences.zh: 医生给了他安定解毒剂，之后他就没事了。

sentences.en: For detectives, this was another interesting lead.
sentences.zh: 对侦探来说，这是另一个有趣的线索。

sentences.en: They wondered if Lindsay had a habit of taking medication that didn't belong to him.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道林赛是否有服用不属于他的药物的习惯。

sentences.en: Judith told the detectives that on Tuesday May 10, she left Grano Street just as Lindsay set off for his afternoon walk, and she didn't see him again after that.
sentences.zh: 朱迪告诉侦探，在5月10日星期二，她离开格拉诺街时林赛正动身去下午散步，自那以后她就再也没见过他。

sentences.en: But detectives were curious about this.
sentences.zh: 但侦探们对这一点感到好奇。

sentences.en: The witness who claimed to have seen Lindsay climbing into a car at 4pm, a short distance from his house, had described the driver as looking exactly like Judith.
sentences.zh: 声称在下午4点看到林赛爬上一辆车的目击者（距离他家不远）将司机描述得看起来和朱迪一模一样。

sentences.en: The car they'd described, an older model brown-coloured sedan with a red LPG sticker on its number plate, also looked just like her vehicle.
sentences.zh: 他们描述的车——一辆较老款的棕色轿车，车牌上有红色LPG贴纸——也长得和她的车一模一样。

sentences.en: Detectives had given Judith's car a once-over when they saw it parked in her driveway.
sentences.zh: 侦探们看到朱迪的车停在车道上时，曾对它进行了粗略检查。

sentences.en: It was a two-tone brown 1982
sentences.zh: 那是一辆双色棕色1982年款

sentences.en: Ford Fairmont Ghia sedan with a red sticker on the number plate to show that the car had been converted to gas.
sentences.zh: 福特费尔蒙吉亚（Ford Fairmont Ghia）轿车，车牌上有一个红色贴纸，表明该车已改装为燃气动力。

sentences.en: It also had Bridgestone Eager S340 tyres, the same type identified at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 它还配备了普利司通Eager S340轮胎，这与在犯罪现场发现的轮胎类型相同。

sentences.en: A cursory look over the vehicle revealed no obvious fresh dents or signs of recent damage.
sentences.zh: 对车辆的初步检查显示没有明显的划痕或近期损坏的迹象。

sentences.en: Judith told the detectives that on the drive home from visiting Lindsay, her car overheated and she had to park by the side of the road for 30 or 40 minutes
sentences.zh: 朱迪告诉侦探，在探望完林赛开车回家的路上，她的车过热了，她不得不把车停在路边30或40分钟

sentences.en: while the engine cooled down.
sentences.zh: 同时发动机冷却下来。

sentences.en: She arrived back in Melton at 7.20pm.
sentences.zh: 她在晚上7点20分回到梅尔顿。

sentences.en: After collecting her young children from the babysitter,
sentences.zh: 接回保姆那里的幼子后，

sentences.en: Judith drove to the local petrol station, filled her car and took it through a car wash.
sentences.zh: 朱迪开车去当地的加油站，给车加满油并开去洗车。

sentences.en: She said she always did this after visiting Lindsay.
sentences.zh: 她说她每次探望完林赛后都会这么做。

sentences.en: This was another red flag for detectives.
sentences.zh: 这对侦探来说是另一个危险信号。

sentences.en: He was always happy and very friendly.
sentences.zh: 他总是很高兴，也非常友好。

sentences.en: On the day Lindsay died, she had been in the main shopping centre of
sentences.zh: 在林赛去世的那天，她一直在

sentences.en: Ararat when she heard Lindsay call to her.
sentences.zh: 阿拉arat的主要购物中心，当时她听到林赛在叫她。

sentences.en: They got chatting, and he told her that he'd had the best day ever, because he was out with his sister.
sentences.zh: 他们聊了起来，他告诉她这是他度过的最棒的一天，因为他和姐姐一起出来玩了。

sentences.en: Lindsay's gravestone says just one thing about him.
sentences.zh: 林赛的墓碑上只写了他的一件事。

sentences.en: Cherished twin brother of Judith.
sentences.zh: 朱迪丝挚爱的双胞胎哥哥。

sentences.en: Judith passed away in 2017.
sentences.zh: 朱迪丝于2017年去世。

sentences.en: She was buried alongside Lindsay, their shared gravestone declaring,
sentences.zh: 她与林赛合葬在一起，他们共用的墓碑上写着：

sentences.en: dearly loved, always remembered, reunited.
sentences.zh: 深切挚爱，永远怀念，重聚团圆。
